solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/mirror-reflection/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

858. Mirror Reflection

There is a special square room with mirrors on each of the four walls. Except for the southwest corner, there are receptors on each of the remaining corners, numbered 0, 1, and 2.

The square room has walls of length p and a laser ray from the southwest corner first meets the east wall at a distance q from the 0th receptor.

Given the two integers p and q, return the number of the receptor that the ray meets first.

The test cases are guaranteed so that the ray will meet a receptor eventually.

Example 1:

Input: p = 2, q = 1
Output: 2
Explanation: The ray meets receptor 2 the first time it gets reflected back to the left wall.

Example 2:

Input: p = 3, q = 1
Output: 1

Constraints:

    1 <= q <= p <= 1000
"""


class Solution:
    def mirrorReflection(self, p: int, q: int) -> int:
        # The problem can be solved by finding the least common multiple (LCM) of p and q.
        # The ray will hit the receptor when the distance traveled vertically is a multiple of p,
        # and the horizontal distance traveled is a multiple of q.
        # Let m = LCM(p, q) / q and n = LCM(p, q) / p.
        # If m is even, the receptor is 2.
        # If m is odd and n is odd, the receptor is 1.
        # If m is odd and n is even, the receptor is 0.

        def gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int:
            while b:
                a, b = b, a % b
            return a

        lcm = p * q // gcd(p, q)
        m = lcm // q
        n = lcm // p

        if m % 2 == 0:
            return 2
        elif n % 2 == 1:
            return 1
        else:
            return 0


sol = Solution()

print(sol.mirrorReflection(2, 1))  # 2

assert sol.mirrorReflection(2, 1) == 2
assert sol.mirrorReflection(3, 1) == 1

assert Solution().mirrorReflection(1, 1) == 1
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(1000, 1) == 2
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(1000, 999) == 2
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(1000, 500) == 2
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(999, 1) == 1
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(999, 500) == 0
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(10, 5) == 2
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(10, 10) == 1
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(6, 4) == 0
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(7, 3) == 1
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(8, 2) == 2
assert Solution().mirrorReflection(1000, 333) == 2
